comment: The list of sessions of the terminal, the file terminal.json (D-293). A scenario reads a file, does the steps and gives what is saved, the groups of one environment and the session the window opens on. The list keeps the order of the person; a group is a folder, in the order the folders first appear. A closed session leaves the list and stays in the file. Not a word of a conversation is in the file. A renamed environment takes its sessions with it.

scenarios.name: no file yet
a broken file is an empty list
a file of another shape is an empty list
the first session gets the folder with a number and becomes the last one
the second session of a folder gets the next number, a name of the person is kept
the numbers are counted in one environment and one folder
groups follow the folders as they first appear, sessions keep the order of the list
the other environment has its own list
an id that is taken, or a session without a folder, is not added
a model is kept as typed, an empty one is no model
renaming, and an empty name that changes nothing
the mode, the model, the start and the time are remembered
going into a session makes it the last one
going into a session that is not there changes nothing
closing the session the window is on moves the window to the next one
closing the last session of the list moves the window to the one before
closing another session leaves the window where it is
closing the only session leaves no session to open
the number of a closed session is free again
what the file does not say gets a plain value, what it says twice is read once
the place of the window is kept in whole units and stays after a new session
a window of no size changes nothing
a window without all four numbers is left out of the file
a renamed environment keeps its sessions
